notes.title: Thank you for 1,000!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/4a241990d8cc661aabaed3b9985275d4fa14572a.png

We officially sold 1,000 copies of Backspace Backspace Backspace. Our tiny game reached this milestone thanks to YOU! We are so grateful for your support and the kind words you shared with us in your reviews. <3

Every little thing you do to help small indie teams like us makes a bigger difference than you can imagine. For instance, your support for Backspace Backspace Backspace has helped us partially fund our next game, Sips and Sonnets, which is already available to wishlist on Steam!

Also, here are some fun Backspace Backspace Backspace statistics. Our top 5 countries are:
1. United States, accounting for 38% of our sales.
2. Saudi Arabia, 8%. 
3. China, 6%.
4. UK, 6%.
5. Turkey, 5%.
Followed by Canada, Brazil, Russia, France, Korea, and Germany!

If you liked Backspace Backspace Backspace, recommend it to your friends, share the news, and leave a Steam review :)

Don't let your creative spark get snuffed out! 

Keep making!
Blue Tango Street

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our second patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed canvas aspect ratio on 1080p monitors, thanks to Abdullah Hamed for the help! 
- Fixed typos in Turkish and minor punctuations in English. 
- Fixed showing the background main menu video on Steam Deck. 
- Music/SFX slider now works! Can't believe we shipped the game while they were broken...

Known bugs to be fixed... Someday: 
- On some devices, after finishing the game and rolling the credits, pressing esc doesn't take you to the main menu :(

notes.title: Localization Update! (Tr + Fr)
notes.content:

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our first patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

Bug Fixes:
- Fix the giant white space at the bottom of the author’s note.
- Fix typos: materialize line 638, Jones line 452.
- Minor script clean-ups. 
- Finishing the game, displaying the credit, going back to main menu, then starting the game again should work fine now (it used to get stuck). 
- Add End of Act2 achievement in Arabic. 
- Pressing ESC while having the return to main menu confirmation message will close it.

Improvements: 
- Reduce time to start the game (from 3 to 2 seconds). 
- Temporarily disable save/load functionality until we fix all its related bugs. Sorry :( This shit is hard…
